selection_basis: Owner asked for preferred BB logic. Fixed B chosen from previously observed eight-market study to reduce strict-C tail loss; not a fresh blind hypothesis.
coverage: Frozen original V1 evaluated cells from covered two-year current-catalog OKX/Binance/Gate pool,30m/1H/4H only; 3534 evaluated of5043 catalog cells; daily excluded. No fetch or outcome-selected symbols.
execution: Frozen original V1 native ledger reported separately; common execution uses next open, signal frozen 5-bar extreme/.2ATR buffer/min2ATR stop,2R activates4ATR trail,0.2% roundtrip costs. Raw unfiltered opposite confirmations close references even if filtered entry is denied. V1 common long uses the same raw V6 short reversal-exit feed as V6/V7 long; native V1 ledger is separate and unchanged. When native V1 long and V6 short coincide, common execution gives exit priority and suppresses same-bar V1 long re-entry, with explicit conflict diagnostics; archived native ledger remains unchanged.
holdout: Owner authorized all dates. Fixed V7 B deployment configuration first evaluation in this new pool; overlapping B data already evaluated before, not fresh blind holdout. Report all reuse.
common_ready: Entry permission requires the same BB threshold history as V7, without requiring compression; original raw reverse signals are kept for exits.

controls.policy: one prespecified matching seed per sampled realized event; same exit feed/risk/cost; common-ready arms also restrict random candidates to BB-ready history; unresolved controls excluded transparently; paired event comparison, not portfolio Random entry candidates likewise exclude opposite raw V6 confirmation on their own signal bar (exit priority).
controls.inference: time-block paired differences where sample permits; no claim of fresh blind validation
controls.sample_selection: SHA256 of entry identity, up to16 realized entries per stream/variant/side, before reading outcome values; all trades remain in performance tables
